vb_textbox.text: if you choose the pink gnome and it gives you a lot of mushrooms, keep picking between the pink and purple as they will be higher than the green and brown. Alternitively, if the pink/purple gnome starts to harvest less mushrooms (3 or below) keep picking between the green and brown. Switch back to the pink and purple gnomes when the green/ brown gnomes start harvesting less again as it alternates between the two pairs. Maybe start with the green and brown pairs to begin with
